snippet.title: Sven – Completely Screwed | Release Trailer | EN
snippet.description:
Play the passionate, immoral ram Sven Bømwøllen and try to bring every sheep from the flock to their climax – but don't get caught by shepherd Lars and his trusty dog Wotan in the process! Spunkier and hotter than ever before!

"Sven – Completely Screwed" releases on 10 August 2023 on PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch & PC!

#sven #svenbomwollen
